q: Which scope do campus buggies and pickup vehicles fall in?
title: Campus buggies and pickups
short: Electric buggies charged on your site are Scope 2, already inside your electricity bill. Diesel or petrol pickups, tractors and buggies you own or lease and operate are Scope 1 from the fuel they burn. Vehicles a contractor owns and fuels are Scope 3.

ul: Fuel issued to each owned vehicle.
A sub-meter on charging points, if you want the split.

p: If buggy charging is already in the site bill, do not add it again as a separate line.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
